title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Create a digital logging system for beekeepers to track hive health, population dynamics, queen status, and mite treatments during field inspections.
latestMessage: Create a digital logging system for beekeepers to track hive health, population dynamics, queen status, and mite treatments during field inspections.

steps.title: Implement Hive Inspection Form and State Management
steps.instruction: Design and implement the front-end form for recording hive inspection metrics including queen presence, brood pattern quality, and honey super fill levels. Integrate IndexedDB for offline data persistence during field inspections.
steps.acceptance: The form must validate input parameters, persist data locally when offline, and successfully sync with the backend database once a connection is re-established.

steps.title: Develop Mite Percentage Calculator and Treatment Decision Tree
steps.instruction: Implement a calculator to process mite counts from alcohol wash or sugar shake samples (mites per 100 bees). Create a conditional UI flow that suggests treatment options based on calculated mite infestation thresholds.
steps.acceptance: The calculation logic must accurately compute infestation percentages and display corresponding treatment alerts when thresholds of 2-3% are exceeded, based on the current season.
